column8: ref_en
Buying? Or selling?\n

column6: いらっしゃい。{08:7F}薬有るよ。\n
column8: Welcome. I've got some good medicine here.\n

column6: 何買い{08:5A}？ {08:7F}薬たくさん有るよ。\n
column8: What'll you buy? Got plenty of good medicine here.\n
You, you're not carrying anything we deal in.\n
What'll you sell?\n
Not enough money troubles me.\n
This is everything you're buying, yes?\n
You, carrying way too much stuff.\n
Can't go down that much. You want me hang myself?\n
Hmmm...... How about this.\n
Good! I'll sell it!\nCustomer good at shopping.\n
Thank you very much.\n
This is everything you're selling, yes?\n

column6: {08:7A}に高く買え{02:0A}。\n私に夜逃げしろ言う{08:55}か？\n
column8: Can't buy that high. You want me skip town?\n
Hmmm...... How about this.\n
Good! I'll buy it!\nCan't win against customer.\n
Thank you very much.\n
Ah, customer. Wait a moment please.\n
Thanks as always. Still got plenty good medicine.\nCome buy lots more again.\n
Thanks as always. Come sell lots more again.\n
Thanks as always. Buy something again next time.\n
This, a bonus. Thank you.\nBetter take it.\n
